title: Solo q1-q3 CLI-Mutation Plan Review
review_scope: Review exact IDs and CLI specs for a later bounded execution gate. Do not authorize mutation from this packet unless a later closure explicitly names exact commands, rollback, audit log, validation evidence, and execution authority.

planned_unit_spec_summary.name: Maatschappelijke kosten verbaal herkennen
planned_unit_spec_summary.kern: Recognize external/social costs not borne by the direct user or producer.
pitfalls: Do not require full MPC/MSC or welfare-loss machinery.
known_risks: q1 over-triggered into formal externality machinery

planned_unit_spec_summary.name: Maatschappelijke kosten uitleggen met voorbeeld
planned_unit_spec_summary.kern: Give a context-specific example and explain why the cost is external/social.
procedure: non-payment by direct user or producer
pitfalls: answer-form need hidden instead of routed to MTU-H4

planned_unit_spec_summary.name: Totale opbrengst puntberekening: TO = P x Q
planned_unit_spec_summary.kern: Calculate total revenue from one price and one quantity without constructing a full TO function.

planned_unit_spec_summary.name: TVK berekenen uit constante variabele kosten
planned_unit_spec_summary.kern: Calculate total variable cost from constant variable cost per unit and quantity.
pitfalls: unit variable cost treated as total cost

planned_unit_spec_summary.name: Onbekende vaste kosten berekenen uit winstvergelijking
planned_unit_spec_summary.kern: Solve W = TO - (TVK + TCK) for unknown fixed costs.
known_risks: reverse calculation hidden as concept-only profit skill

planned_unit_spec_summary.name: Schaalfactoren in examencijfers toepassen
planned_unit_spec_summary.kern: Handle labels such as x 1.000 in formulas, graphs, and final answers.

planned_unit_spec_summary.name: GO herkennen als prijsfunctie van de monopolist
planned_unit_spec_summary.kern: Recognize GO/demand as the monopoly price relation P(Q).
known_risks: q3 price step hidden inside profit-max route

planned_unit_spec_summary.name: MO bepalen zonder afgeleiden
planned_unit_spec_summary.kern: Determine/use MO through table, graph, or linear rule before calculus.
procedure: use MO = a - 2bQ for linear P

planned_unit_spec_summary.name: MO bepalen met afgeleide
planned_unit_spec_summary.kern: Update live A12 to clarify derivative MO from TO.
pitfalls: derivative route used when non-calculus route suffices
planned_unit_spec_summary.rollback_path: restore previous A12 JSON through reviewed unit-update rollback

planned_unit_spec_summary.name: MO = gegeven MK oplossen
planned_unit_spec_summary.kern: Solve MO = MK when MK is a given constant/value.
pitfalls: MK derivation when MK is given

planned_unit_spec_summary.name: MO = afgeleide MK oplossen
planned_unit_spec_summary.kern: Update or split live A20 as the derived-MK route after usage audit.
planned_unit_spec_summary.rollback_path: restore previous A20 JSON or reviewed split/deprecate rollback
known_risks: active broad/given-MK mappings require split route

planned_unit_spec_summary.name: Nieuwe prijs bepalen na winstmaximaliserende Q
planned_unit_spec_summary.kern: Substitute Q* into GO/P(Q) to determine the new price.
pitfalls: old price reused after cost change

planned_unit_spec_summary.name: Procentuele prijsverandering na kostenverandering
planned_unit_spec_summary.kern: Calculate percentage price change with old price as denominator and distinguish it from pass-through.
pitfalls: percentage price rise is not percentage of cost shock passed on
known_risks: price-change route blurred with incidence/pass-through family

calibration_questions.question: This gate reviews exact ID and CLI-spec planning only and does not authorize protected reference mutation, machine-reference mutation, unit minting, unit update execution, lesson output, or student/product use.
Proposed IDs F19, F20, and A85 through A93 are planning proposals, not live unit IDs, until a later explicitly authorized CLI execution sprint runs.

planned_questions.preferred_option: approve F19 and F20 as two units for later execution-gate planning
approve A85 through A88 as separate later execution-gate specs
approve A89/A90/A91 additions and A12/A20 updates for later execution-gate planning
approve A92 and A93 while keeping D07 incidence in MTU-H3
decide whether direct unit-add execution is acceptable or dry-run wrapper is required
require command log, diff, rollback, audit, validators, reports, and Jest proof
authorize only a later bounded CLI execution gate packet unless exact execution authority is separately confirmed
no mutation or product authority now

stop_conditions: Stop if hand edits to references/machine/ or references/external/ are authorized.
Stop if mutation execution is authorized without exact command, rollback, audit, and validation authority.
Stop if q1 requires full MPC/MSC or welfare-loss machinery.
Stop if q2 requires full TO-function construction.
Stop if q3 requires MK derivation when MK is given or a calculus-only MO route.
Stop if q1 or q2 answer-form needs are hidden instead of routed to MTU-H4.
Stop if D07 broader incidence/pass-through work is mutated from this gate.
Stop if diagnostics, adaptive routing, mastery, sequencing, student-facing AI, summative use, PV projection, PV machine promotion, or student/product use is authorized.
recommended_next_action: Run the formal GATE-MTU-H2A human review before any later CLI execution packet, unit minting, unit update execution, candidate storage, lesson handoff, or student/product use.
